summary: Fixed the Windows installer progress header and installation-details controls.
details: The installer retains NSIS's native file progress and uses an isolated observer to derive the displayed percentage and time estimate from that exact green bar.
The estimated time remaining refreshes every five seconds and never displays more than five minutes.

The detailed output panel remains collapsed by default, reuses one native control for matching Show details and Hide details states, and no longer repeats an Installing header above the progress view.
